title: Action of the tail shear
statement: For every natural number $m$, every vector $x\\in(\\mathbb{F}_2)^m$, and all $a,b\\in\\mathbb{F}_2$, the tail shear linear equivalence sends $(x,(a,b))$ to $(x,(a+\\sum_{i=1}^m x_i,\\ b+\\sum_{i=1}^m x_i))$.
